title: HELD FIRE AND SHELL RELOADS
why: His g-15: Yes, hold to repeat; g-12: Yes, shell by shell; g-75: Yes, fire stops it. LOCAL: no linked review. Check 31.99 was retargeted by the coordinator to pulse the weapon probe before this change. Watch: the Lance empties its three rounds in about 0.13 s when held and the Rocket Launcher fires both rockets 0.7 s apart; tapping fire out of habit with rounds left can cancel a reload; listen for the end pump when a shell reload is cut and whether a one-shell top-up still taking 2.4 s feels slow.
now: Magazine guns repeat at their existing fire rate while held. Shotguns load usable shells at each shell sound and keep their full reload time. A fresh loaded trigger cancels reload before cooldown or MG spin permits firing. Held and dry pulls let the reload finish. Cuts keep loaded shells and lose the active chain. The bot sim stays one go.
